description: This file defines a JavaScript module that initializes and manages line chart components on a webpage using Chart.js. It registers chart components, defines helper functions for theme-based styling, and exports a function to set up line charts on specified canvas elements, including dynamic theme updates via MutationObserver.

methods.name: getTextColor()
methods.description: Returns text color based on current theme (dark or light).

methods.name: getGridColor()
methods.description: Returns grid line color based on current theme (dark or light).

methods.name: initLineCharts()
methods.description: Initializes line charts on canvas elements with the class 'cbms-line-chart', setting up data, styles, and theme responsiveness.
